strategy.primary: Unearth reanimator: self-mill and discard creatures, then use Sedris's granted unearth {2}{B} (down to {B} with Convergence of Dominion) to return ETB creatures each turn, with Panharmonicon doubling their ETBs.
strategy.secondary: Keep unearthed creatures by ending the turn with Obeka or Sundial, or phasing them with Teferi's Veil; Deadeye Navigator + Peregrine Drake is the combo package.

commander_oracle_snapshots.name: Sedris, the Traitor King
commander_oracle_snapshots.oracle_text: Each creature card in your graveyard has unearth {2}{B}. ({2}{B}: Return the card to the battlefield. The creature gains haste. Exile it at the beginning of the next end step or if it would leave the battlefield. Unearth only as a sorcery.)

identity.why: Unearth {2}{B} for every creature card in the graveyard.
Ends the turn to keep unearthed creatures.
Rescue piece and half of the combo.
